# html.frontend and html.backend are identity functions whose whole meaning is
# that the call is there. Their `=> v` bodies are placeholders like any other
# intrinsic's, so the checker must drop them — otherwise the const folder
# inlines the identity, the call disappears, and the placement guard never sees
# the directive it was written to reject.
#
# They are the one pair of marked declarations that lives in a namespace's
# synthetic package rather than on a type, so a drop that walks only types and
# packages misses them.
! sngl generate --lang none --platform html -o out backend_const.sngl
stderr 'html.backend'
stderr 'not yet implemented'

-- backend_const.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

var v int = html.backend(42)

component App {
    vbox {
        text(value="{v}")
    }
}

window #main(title="t", href="/") {
    App()
}
